We would be happy to offer you a complimentary company profile on HOOG.design. This profile allows you to present My Villa and your completed projects to our network of architecture, interior design and design enthusiasts.

Important regarding project submissions: at HOOG.design, we only publish professional photography of completed projects. Renders, 3D visualizations and other computer-generated images cannot be used as project photography. Our focus is on showcasing realized architecture and interior projects.



You are, of course, very welcome to share relevant material with us. For now, we would be delighted if you could create your company profile and add your completed projects.

Onderwerp: The privacy threshold in your family villa feature

Hi Hoog team,

(Writing to the Hoog newsroom directly — this is meant for whichever
desk is closest to the topic below. Feel free to forward as
appropriate.)

Enjoyed your feature on the modern family villa. The street elevation
giving depth and privacy while the rear opens to the trees is the
whole idea of the house in one move, and you named it clearly.

A quick hello from our side: at My Villa, we bring European
construction resilience and the Italian way of living to homes in Los
Angeles, designed in exposed reinforced concrete, cemento a vista.

One thought your piece sparked: in Mediterranean building, that
threshold between closed and open is handled by mass rather than
cladding, which is why the same houses read as both private and
generous.

Would you be interested in receiving more material on what we are
doing, or in setting up a short call with our founder Paolo?

Best,
Lisa Monelli
My Villa Media Team
info@myvilla.la · myvilla.la
